scope: Separate local DI Dashboard within repository; original app stays at root with its existing code
requirements_source: User feedback and explicit choice of local module; Open-Meteo coordinate requests approved 23 October 2026; separate spring/pump assessment, source intake and OpenStreetMap tile consent on 23 October 2026

decisions.runtime: Python 3.11+ standard-library ThreadingHTTPServer, local loopback only
decisions.rationale: Runs without pip installation; existing local prototype and small single-team workload. Replace transport with FastAPI if shared deployment is required.
decisions.alternative: FastAPI + PostgreSQL provides stronger generated API schemas and multi-user scaling but adds deployment dependencies unnecessary for this local prototype.
decisions.frontend: React 18, Vite, bundled local font; built assets included
decisions.auth: None, as requested; do not expose beyond localhost
decisions.database: SQLite WAL; foreign keys; transactions; SQL tables with validated versioned JSON records
decisions.extensibility: Domain validation, storage, environmental connector, transport and UI modules separated; no LLM calls

modules.backend/store.py: SQLite schema, transactions, site versions, immutable submitted visits, corrections, attachments, environmental cache, request replay; public checkout has no seed site records
modules.backend/rules.py: Canonical validation, raw readings to SI conversions, active visit selection, comparison rules, 90-day totals and roof arithmetic; never accesses file content
modules.backend/weather.py: Approved automatic rainfall retrieval, cache, retry, provider parsing and lineage
modules.server.py: Local HTTP transport, API error responses, static UI, original supporting file storage/download
modules.src/forms.jsx: One-time setup and three-step portal entry
modules.src/views.jsx: Overview, site list/detail, tracking, framework and visit review
modules.backend/assessment.py: Independent asset comparisons, maintenance denominators, indicator register version 3.0 and portfolio rollups
modules.src/maps.jsx: Local Leaflet maps, independent coordinate pickers, approved OpenStreetMap tiles
modules.src/controls.jsx: Accessible custom dropdown and calendar components
modules.src/evidence.jsx: Site photographs and paginated manually documented source records

api.result: sites[], visits[], attachments[], weather_jobs[], weather{coordinate_key:record}, assessment.sites[]

api.body: Visit fields and submit:boolean; id for existing draft, supersedes and correction_reason for correction
api.result: Validated submitted visit or incomplete database draft
Supporting file metadata with SHA-256; original bytes stored without extraction
All visits including drafts and superseded versions, raw detail JSON per row
Consistent database snapshot; copy attachment directory separately

api.body: Raw bytes, application/octet-stream; site_id, optional visit_id, name, kind, asset query parameters
api.result: Original bytes up to 25 MB; SHA-256 deduplication per site/visit/kind; evidence record; site cover update when requested

conditional: Measured spring: exactly three positive litres/seconds readings, measurement point, full/partial capture
Optional handpump delivery: three readings and procedure, only for working pump
Water test: parameter, value, sample location and kit/lab
Some changes: at least one area/direction/before/after/basis account; who if people_said
Correction: valid submitted visit at same site and reason
data_contract.evidence: Portal-entered fields only in the public source package. Uploaded files are supporting evidence and are never parsed.
data_contract.history: Site versions append; submitted visits immutable; a correction supersedes an earlier submitted visit, which remains stored; drafts excluded from assessment. No destructive deletion API. Initial source visits use source_recorded data flags; correction history is retained.
data_contract.units: Raw litres and seconds retained; L/min = mean(litres*60/seconds), m3/s = L/min/60000; rainfall mm and m; roof m2; potential collection m3

assessment_rules.comparison: Most recent reading against earlier reading at same site, season, method, point and full capture on different dates. Unknown season and partial capture excluded. No interpolation or annual extrapolation. Spring and handpump compared independently; source date windows excluded. Match handpump identity before applying equipment status.
assessment_rules.missing: Not measured is missing; observed dry spring is zero; unavailable rain is not zero; percent change from zero undefined
assessment_rules.rain: 90 consecutive available daily values; date range retained; recent window ends at last available provider day
assessment_rules.roof: rain_mm * roof_area_m2 * collection_factor / 1000; estimate of collectable water only
assessment_rules.attribution: Changes may reflect rainfall, solar pumping, repairs, pipes or other works. DI share unknown. No impact score, causal claim or predictive model.
assessment_rules.wider_changes: Repeated dated before/now accounts with seen versus people_said labels, not a survey statistic or guaranteed causal loop
assessment_rules.weights: No composite DI impact score. Three flow repeats each weight 1/3; each checked asset counts once; missing statuses excluded with visible denominators.

rainfall_connector.privacy: No site names, people, notes or files sent. User consent recorded in conversation; coordinate transmission explicitly approved.
rainfall_connector.cadence: Check every 60 seconds while service runs; cache successful responses 24h, retry failures after 1h; no request without GPS; reuse identical coordinate cache
rainfall_connector.period: At least two years, extend for older visits; stop seven days before current local date for publication lag
rainfall_connector.lineage: Full response JSON, checksum, coordinate grid/request, model, retrieval time, date vector and unit saved in database
rainfall_connector.limits: ERA5 area estimate about 25km, mountain rainfall may differ; no rainfall-to-recharge inference; source licence/plan review needed for broader deployment
rainfall_connector.tls: HTTPS certificate verification is always enabled. On Windows, a bundled-Python trust-store error falls back to backend/fetch_weather.ps1 using the normal Windows HTTPS client.

reliability.writes: Explicit saves; transaction per mutation; idempotent submit replay; unique correction index
reliability.environment: Loading, ready, needs_gps and failed jobs; failed refresh retains old cache; bounded request timeout
reliability.observability: Local Python log and weather job status; no analytics, browser storage or tracking
reliability.backup: Consistent SQLite snapshot plus runtime/attachments, data/00_raw and public/photos
reliability.future: Shared use requires authenticated roles, managed persistence, migrations, operational logging and deployment hardening

map.consent: Explicit user approval 23 October 2026, stored in meta.osm_tiles_consent
map.privacy: Only viewed tile areas sent; no site labels, files or notes
map.locations: Independent spring/pump coordinates; no inferred duplication; association not proof of hydraulic connection
map.offline: Manual coordinates remain available; map failure states visible

initial_intake.distribution: Not included in public branch. Field intake scripts, datasets, original documents, photographs and manifests remain local. The public checkout starts empty.
